name: Alternating bidirectional propagation qualifier
aliases: Alternating bidirectional propagation qualifier IEC reference
summary: This qualifier identifies opposite-direction propagation occurring alternately.
description: This qualifier identifies opposite-direction propagation occurring alternately. The two directions are used at different times, making the temporal relationship different from simultaneous two-way propagation. The underlying link can still appear as a single path.
Record which functions send and receive and how the documented operation changes direction. Do not interpret the qualifier as two independent physical cables.
